Container.Name: sabthrottle
Container.Overview: Throttles SABnzbd automatically while Jellyfin is actively streaming (e.g. via NZBDav), so streams always have enough bandwidth. Also supports user-configurable time-based speed profiles (e.g. weekdays 7-17 = 50%, nights = 100%) via a built-in WebUI.
Container.Description: Polls Jellyfin for active playback sessions and adjusts the SABnzbd speed limit dynamically. While at least one stream is active, SABnzbd is throttled. When all streams end, full speed is restored. Additionally supports user-configurable time-based speed profiles (e.g. weekdays 7-17 = 50%, nights = 100%) configured directly in the built-in WebUI. Rules and settings are persisted to /config so they survive container restarts.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the WebUI and API listen on

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Where rules.json and settings.json are stored.

Config.Name: SABNZBD_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your SABnzbd instance

Config.Name: SABNZBD_API_KEY
Config.Description: SABnzbd API key (Config -> General -> API Key)

Config.Name: THROTTLE_PERCENT
Config.Description: Initial throttle percent while a Jellyfin stream is active (seeds settings.json on first start; can be changed in the WebUI later)

Config.Name: FULL_PERCENT
Config.Description: Initial default speed limit (percent) when no stream and no rule is active (seeds settings.json on first start; can be changed in the WebUI later)

Config.Name: LINE_SPEED_MBIT
Config.Description: Optional: your real internet line speed in Mbit/s. Used so percent values can be displayed as MB/s and compared with absolute (Mbit/s, MB/s) rules. 0 = unknown.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_URL
Config.Description: Optional: Jellyfin base URL. If set together with JELLYFIN_API_KEY, sabthrottle polls Jellyfin directly and the Webhook plugin is not needed.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key (Dashboard -> API Keys). Required for polling mode.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_POLL_INTERVAL_SEC
Config.Description: Poll interval in seconds (only used in polling mode)

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional shared secret to authenticate the Jellyfin webhook (only used in webhook mode)

Config.Name: NZBDAV_PATH_PREFIX
Config.Description: If set, only throttle when the playing item path contains this string (e.g. /mnt/user/nzbdav)
